name: Bristling Spines (Moderate)
text:
Your exposed skin is covered in fine, needle-like hairs that you can flick into the eyes of enemies.

---
Activate—Urticating Burst 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You flick tiny spines in a 15-foot cone, dealing 2d8 piercing damage to all creatures in the area with a DC 18 basic Reflex save save. On a critical failure, the creature is also Dazzled until the end of their next turn.
